messages:
morgan: Heads up—we ran into a tail latency burst during the EU->US write failover test. Proposal: introduce 'write-escape' that lets proxies forward writes to a secondary region after X ms, with clear residency tagging + audit trail. Thoughts?
adele: Can you paste the failure pattern? Is this about KV lease not being visible across regions?
morgan: Yes. Repro steps: 1) primary EU fails mid-window 2) client retried, proxy waits 250ms for primary response 3) if no response, we either queue or forward. We saw queuing causes long tail and client timeouts.
chris: If we forward, we break residency SLA unless tenant is allowed fallback. Need explicit per-tenant policy.
dinesh: Agree. Need per-tenant consent + write tag. Could we make it opt-in? Default: reject or enqueue. Opt-in: allow escape with audit.
samir: :thinking: Also worried about split-brain semantics. If primary comes back and applied later, will we have double-writes? Need idempotency keys and conflict resolution.
morgan: Plan: 1) proxy waits configurable latency (250ms) 2) if lease not reachable, and tenant policy = escape, proxy forwards to fallback region with header 'X-Residency-Escaped: true' and idempotency token. 3) Write store accepts if token unused, persists audit event. 4) Background reconciler compares version vectors.
adele: Reconciler complexity seems heavy. Do we have expectation of many escapes? If low, reconciler OK. If high, could overload.
chris: Also legal: some tenants cannot leave EU. Policy must be enforced in control plane + SDK errors telling app what happened.
dinesh: Telemetry: increment escape_count, escape_latency; expose per-tenant dashboard and alert if > threshold.
samir: Conflict resolution: prefer last-write-wins? That can lose data. Better: CRDT for certain objects, or application-level merge hints. But that's a longer roadmap.
morgan: Agreed. Minimal viable: idempotency + last-wins with clear audit trail and 'reconcile recommended' flag pushed to customer. Longer-term: per-object CRDTs for embeddings/streams.
chris: Implementation notes: proxy change is small. Need to extend residency policy API: allow 'escape: allow|deny|audit-only' and a grader for cost.
morgan: Security: escaped writes must be encrypted with tenant KMS and key rotation preserved. Also log an encrypted audit record stored in EU.
dinesh: Operator playbook: can block escapes globally in case of legal incident. Also a metric-backed throttle to prevent mass escape during a regional outage.
samir: Edge-case: what if proxy forwards but primary actually accepted earlier but response delayed? With idempotency keys we'll dedupe, but we must ensure token uniqueness across regions (use UUID v4).
adele: Can we expose a 409 to SDK when conflict detected, with a reconcile token? Apps can choose to refetch etc.
morgan: Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC adding policy schema + proxy change + reconciler sketch. Can someone volunteer to own the reconciler POC? @dinesh?
dinesh: I'll take POC for reconciler. Will mock the vector compare and a reconciliation queue.
chris: I'll update policy API docs and SDK error codes.
samir: I'll write the idempotency + token contract and the audit encryption notes.
platform-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-6654 for write-escape feature workstream.
morgan: :thumbsup: thanks folks. I'll post RFC link when ready.
